summary: BMW Auto Leasing LLC filed an 8-K reporting entry into material definitive agreements tied to the October 14, 2026 closing of BMW Vehicle Lease Trust 2026-2, an auto-lease asset-backed securitization. The Trust issued five classes of Class A asset-backed notes totaling roughly $1.2495 billion: $223.0M A-1, $305.6M A-2a, $175.0M A-2b, $480.6M A-3 and $65.8M A-4. Ancillary documents include the 2026-2 Vehicle Trust Supplement, SUBI certificate transfers from BMW Manufacturing to BMW LLC to the Trust, and related agreements. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or equity stake applies; this is ordinary ABS issuance, not a special situation. Watch only collateral performance and note spreads.
